name: B / Control Room
purpose: 通过一条 Pico USB 观察三个异步更新的测距通道，并让超时与时间语义保持可见。
differentiation: Dominant 30-second oscillograph, fixed session rail, vertically stacked channel telemetry, and timestamped raw records; no three-card dashboard hero.
scope: Design preview only. No navigator.serial, device access, hardware, application integration, fetch, or network calls.

mobile.layout: Compact top session controls; two-column telemetry with full-width laser; full-width chart below; compact record table and collapsed diagnosis.

tokens.localPreviewFallback: Instrument Sans bundled as fallback for Space Grotesk; IBM Plex Mono bundled; Chinese uses installed Noto Sans SC or PingFang SC.

content.timingNote: 三路异步更新；TF 解析间隔不等于真实采样间隔；原始单位只影响 TFmini。
